before: - **Who must file.** A person with no wages must file if total income is above the basic allowance (twice that for spouses assessed jointly) ([§ 56 EStDV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estdv_1955/__56.html)). A return is also compulsory if a remaining loss deduction was formally determined at the end of the previous year, for example a private-sales loss carried forward (§ 56 sentence 2 EStDV). An employee must be assessed if untaxed side income, such as taxable crypto gains or staking income, is more than the § 46(2) no. 1 EStG amount in the figures table; for an employee who is assessed, such income is deducted again if it is not more than that amount in total, and above it a regulation softens the step up to full taxation (§ 46(3) and (5), [§ 46 EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__46.html)).
after: - **Who must file.** A person with no wages must file if total income is above the basic allowance (twice that for spouses assessed jointly) ([§ 56 EStDV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estdv_1955/__56.html)). A return is also compulsory if a remaining loss deduction was formally determined at the end of the previous year, for example a private-sales loss carried forward (§ 56 sentence 2 EStDV). An employee must be assessed if untaxed side income, such as taxable crypto gains or staking income, is more than the § 46(2) no. 1 EStG amount in the figures table; for an employee assessed under § 46(2), § 46(3) deducts only eligible non-withheld taxable income totalling not more than EUR 410, excluding income subjected to the tariff under § 32d(6). Reduce that deduction by the statutory excess Altersentlastungsbetrag over the § 24a percentage of wages excluding § 19(2) pension receipts, and by the § 13(3) amount. Stipulated eligible income of EUR 400 with a EUR 100 statutory reduction gives EUR 300 deduction; with neither reduction it gives EUR 400. Above EUR 410, apply the separately gated § 70 EStDV hardship route/qualified freelancer companion rather than promising a full deduction (§ 46(3) and (5), [§ 46 EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__46.html)).
